full_judgment: 3. That Md. Abdul Malek, the present respondent No.1, as the plaintiff respondent other class Suit No. 28 of 1996 for declaration of titled and partition stating inter alia that all acre of land out of 22 acre appertaining c.s. Khatian No.1, plot No.2795 owned by CS recorded owner Noresh Chandra Basu and others. They on 29.07.1940, transferred the same along with others land to Bashanta Kumari Das by registered by sale deed, who dead leaving behind her only son Jyoti Bikash as her heirs: Jyoti Bikash subsequently transferred the same along with 18 acre of lane from others plots to Abdur Rahim's was duly recorded in R.S operation after the death of Abdur Rahim inter property developed upon his six sons (defendant No. 3 to 7 and 17) seven daughters (defendant No. 8 to 12 and 19 to 20, and widow (defended No. 18) by a requested by amicable partition No.3361 dated 05.02.1978 defendants No.8 to 12 got the said all acre of land whereupon defendant No. 12 transferred .01 acre of land on 24.04.1979 to defendant No.13 (father of defendant No.2), who is his transferred the same to the plaintiff and defended No. 2 (brother of plaintiff) registered heba-bil-ewaj dated 19.01.1986 on the other hand defendant No.17 (Rafique Ahmed Sayed) another son of Abdur Rahim who was minor in the time of partition after at-tainting majority transferred .01. acre of land to the plaintiff and defendant No.2, by Kabala dated 22.09.1997 and on the same days by another Kabala transferred .01, acre of land to defended No.15, Thus the plaintiff claims that since his presence he is remaining shop said .01 acre of land and demanded petitioner of the same but his demand being refused he instituted the instant suit.
